The development of mobile phone screen protector has become a very common electronic accessory.

Mobile phone protective film gets popular with the rise of smart phones, but now more and more consumers refuse to get a screen protector for their smartphones, because the smartphone display is becoming more durable, mobile phone manufacturers use various new technologies to make the display screen not easy to scratch and break, meanwhile, which makes the major function of the mobile phone screen protector disappear.
In order to continue the lifeline of screen protector products, manufacturers are constantly innovating and bringing forth new products.

Nowadays, there are many sub-categories in screen protector, such as high definition screen protector, frosted film, privacy screen protector, mirrored protective film, hydrogel film, blue light blocking screen protector, etc. .
Anti-blue light screen protector is one of them.
The selling point of the blue light blocking screen protector is that it is able to block the blue light from mobile phone display, thereby protecting eyes.
Manufacturer claims that the anti-blue light screen protector can block the harmful blue light emitted by most mobile phone displays, protect eyes, healthier for eyesight, and not easy to fatigue.
Nowadays, people spend more and more time on their mobile phone, protecting their eyes is no-doubt a big selling point.
Why blocking blue light?
Blue light is harmful for health.
The wavelength of visible light in nature is from 400nm to 700nm, and from 400nm to 500nm, the color that our eyes perceive is blue, so this band is called blue light.
The blue light that we are exposed to the most in our daily life comes from various LCD screens, mobile phones, tablets, computers or TV sets, these devices emits LED blue light.
It can easily pass through the lens of the eye and reach the retina, causing permanent damage to the retina of the eye.

Being in a blue light environment for a long time (playing mobile phones, computers, watching TV, etc. for a long time) will cause oxidation and lesions in the macular area of the eye. , and cause great damage to the eyes, the risk of macular degeneration is doubled.
In short words, this is the reason why manufacturers introduce anti-blue light screen protector.
How does anti-blue light screen protector block harmful blue light?

Anti-blue light screen protector mainly to block the high energy short-wave blue light emitted by the LCD/LED screen, the principle is to greatly reduce the stimulation of blue light on the eyes by absorbing and refracting too much short-wave blue light from the screen, effectively relieving dry eyes, red eyes, eye pain and eye fatigue, thus better protecting your eyesight.
At present, the anti-blue light screen protector on the market are mainly based on tempered glass film s, and most products use AB glue containing anti-blue light feature to block blue light.
OCA (Optically Clear Adhesive) acts on tempered glass, the optical-grade basic material itself blocks blue light, which relieves visual fatigue to a certain extent.
A small number of manufacturers’ anti-blue light tempered glass screen protector is to spray anti-blue light material on the surface of tempered glass, referred as coating technology.

The anti-blue light material is applied to the surface of tempered glass film through coating, benefit is that the definition of mobile phone display will not be decreased when such tempered glass film is attached on.
How effective is the anti-blue light tempering film for cell phones?
After talking about so much about blue light hazards, then consumers must also want to know how effective the anti-blue light protective film is in order to judge if they should buy it or not.
In fact, many consumers do not know how much the effect of anti-blue light film will be, they just think that it can simply prevent blue light and that’s all.
Things’ not easy.
One parameter of the anti-blue light protective film is the blue light blocking rate.
The most exaggerated merchants even claim that their products can block 99% of blue light.
But unfortunately, this is not actually possible.
Ocushield, a specific brand in the field of anti-blue light tempered protective film, can only claim that efficiency of their anti-blue light glass is 54%.
This is frustrated, the fact is that most anti-blue light protective films using the AB glue process are usually able to block about 10% of blue light.
This may be very different from what you think, but it is the truth.

At the same time, due to the characteristics of AB glue, it also reduces the light transmittance, thereby reducing the clarity of the mobile phone display, so using this kind of anti-blue light film really kills you, while you think it protects your eyes, it also indirectly hurts your eyes.
The anti-blue light protective film with the coating process is better than the AB glue ones.
The anti-blue light protective film with coating technology does not use the anti-blue light AB glue at all.
This kind of tempered glass applies the anti-blue light coating to the surface of the tempered glass film, it blocks more blue light and meanwhile it ensure the transmittance of tempered film itself.
The blocking rate of blue light can generally reach more than 40%.
Another point is anti-UV light.
Many manufacturer claims their anti-blue light protective films can also block UV light.
However, when we try to think something more, we will find that this is actually a false proposition.
Mobile phone displays, computers, and TV displays actually generate negligible UV light, so the so-called anti-UV light doesn’t even make sense.
You may find more explanation about it here regarding whether UV exists in the TV and mobile phone display.
So if you should choose an anti-blue light screen protector for your mobile phone?
Yes and no.
Yes if you spend long time on your mobile phone everyday, and no if buy the general one.
